results.input: What is self-attention in a Transformer?
results.expected_output: Self-attention allows each token to consider other tokens in the input sequence when building its representation. It uses query, key, and value representations to calculate attention.
results.actual_output: Self‑attention is the mechanism the Transformer uses to compute representations of its input and output entirely through attention over the sequence itself, without relying on recurrence or convolution. It lets each token attend to every other token in the sequence, weighting their contributions to form a new representation. This approach enables the model to capture long‑range dependencies directly.
